name: rapid_topic_switching
description: Tests the AI's ability to handle rapid topic switching across multiple messages without losing context or becoming confused

messages.text: wait, do you sell tools too?

expected_behaviors.description: Each reply should arrive within 15 seconds
AI should respond to each message, not crash
AI should handle each topic change gracefully and address the current question

forbidden_patterns.pattern: (error|null|undefined|NaN|exception|stack trace|I'm confused|I don't understand what you want)
forbidden_patterns.description: AI should not break down or express confusion when topics change rapidly

notes: User rapidly switches topics across 3 messages with 5-second delays: first asking for a board quote, then asking for the address, then asking about tools. The AI should handle each message in context, addressing the current question without getting confused by the topic changes.
